title: Cover force-exit omitted from matched launcher request and stage arguments
outcome: A focused Node command containing --test-force-exit cannot receive passing credit from a request/stage record that omits the flag, including mutually consistent altered artifacts.
acceptance: Regression cases remove --test-force-exit from the recorded request args alone and from both request args and stage command while retaining it in the observed command; native exit0 and positive counts still yield no passing credit.
The focused Node recognition tests pass with the existing exact-argument validator preserved.
